item.title: Seismic evidence for double slab tears at the Neo-Tethyan subduction–collision transition
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 04 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02129-4

The slab at the transition between the Makran subduction and Zagros collision zones in southeastern Iran is torn in two places, which may accommodate the differential plate motion, according to an interpretation of seismic tomographic imaging.
